understand.restatement: Given a nonempty array nums of nonnegative integers, start at index 0. Each value is the maximum number of positions you may jump forward from there. Return whether you can reach the final index.
understand.outputs: Whether the last index is reachable.

pattern.name: Greedy
pattern.why: Scan reachable indices while maintaining the farthest position any of them can reach. A gap beyond that boundary makes the end unreachable.
pattern.recognize: Scan reachable indices while maintaining the farthest position any of them can reach. A gap beyond that boundary makes the end unreachable.

approach.brute_force: For each position, inspect all earlier reachable positions to decide whether any can jump to it; this takes O(n²) time.
